authorization: User requested one WL84 references_and_candidates style image comparing 8DNA on the ReST-GI checkerboard interreflection dataset.
classification: Dependent static baseline visual follow-up, WL21B; no new architecture hypothesis or dynamic-recovery comparison.
scene: Frozen CK2 from WL93D checkerboard addendum revision 2; bx38, original 512-square camera and point light.
materials: Exact frozen WL86 ER states through unchanged DrClosure83, including original 0.3/0.8 Lambert constructor on all 54 box A checker patches. No principled/GGX substitution.
8dna_asset: One source-independent prebaked composite of S1 panel and checker box A. All other room surfaces, sphere, box B and the light must be AABB-disjoint. No public asset checkpoint is transferred to CK2.
normalization: One uniform global scene-coordinate change; point intensity scaled by inverse length-scale squared. Identity instance transform avoids upstream non-unit-scale query limitations. Appearance must agree with original CK2 before training.

preflight.closure: Exact plugin eval/pdf agreement and sampled weights with unchanged frozen ER; checker ids match independently computed old patch ids at all center hits away from seams
preflight.geometry: Camera center-ray front/panel/checker masks match saved 512-square CK2 masks >= 0.999; point emitter outside prebaked asset
preflight.radiometry: Native six-event ER path tracer vs stored CK2 REF-ER, at 512 spp initially, with discrepancy and reference-noise reported; no comparison label if bridge fails

training.architecture_loss_optimizer: Unmodified upstream train.py and default model
training.execution_deviations: Path-generation batch SPP 32 instead of 256 and validation spp 16 instead of 128 to fit 12GB; same 128^4 path buffer, architecture, loss and native 30-epoch training budget. Fixed final checkpoint; no image-based checkpoint selection or tuning.
training.preview: A first-epoch snapshot may be rendered and labelled 1/30 epochs, preliminary; it cannot stand for the final fixed fit.

evaluation.neural: Native neuralpath, max_depth 10, rr_depth 5, 2x256 spp, seeds 21201/21202
evaluation.stored_rest_gi: Frozen WL92A own s8601, C0, stored WL93D CK2 bx38 renders (2x4096 spp); preserve REF LOW + predicted higher-order composition and label it
evaluation.stored_reference: CK2 REF-ER, 4x8192 spp, six scattering events
evaluation.independent_native_reference: Same frozen ER, native prb at six events for bridge, plus 16 events for truncation diagnostic; native unlimited transport and six-event target are different regimes. No strict same-event-fidelity or speed winner is inferred if the remaining depth mismatch is material.
evaluation.rows: Full frame and fixed panel-reflection crop from saved ROI_T; no error-driven crop selection
evaluation.columns: REF-ER / ReST-GI C0 / 8DNA / ReST-GI absolute HDR error / 8DNA absolute HDR error
evaluation.display: WL84 x/(1+x), gamma 2.2, fixed exposure for all candidates; sqrt(mean_RGB(abs(error))), one shared viridis error scale with colorbar
evaluation.interpretation: Static qualitative comparison only. Different per-asset versus multi-geometry learning lifecycles/budgets disclosed. No T0/T1 invalidation, Neural Full Recompute, dynamic reuse, training-time superiority or model adoption claim.

scheduling: Wait for the current public asset job to finish while its dispatcher is held. Run CK2 alone; on exit restore the prior dispatcher. Never stop unrelated processes.
